value.rationale: The complete incidence/extension spectrum is a natural refinement of the maximum noncommuting set invariant in a family that realizes the recent sharp central-index bound. It gives a sharp all-arity classification, a universal parity obstruction, unique completion for (2r-2)-cliques, all-rank closed multiplicities, and a concrete family of clique designs; the theorem is not a parameter rename or finite-table recomputation. It separates max size from abundance and determines fine local structure relevant to sampling and studying extremal noncommuting configurations.
